audit.summary: The released ATE evaluator computes mean aligned distance rather than RMSE; an explicit full-rank witness reverses rankings. Persistent twelve-scalar attributes contradict the core five-scalar storage account. Historical run consequences remain unresolved. Local comparative and aggregate errors are Minor.
limitations: P1 — Released tracking metric is not ATE RMSE — Counterevidence: Current release not certified historical experiment version; raw trajectories and logs absent. Depth-L1 published metric is not invalidated by ancillary depth-RMSE naming defect.

P2 — Persistent storage exceeds claimed five-scalar representation — Counterevidence: Five optimized attributes and9/14 abstract arithmetic are correct; zero learning rates do not remove arrays. CPU offloading and head-pose center update are real. No total-memory or scalability failure is inferred.

P3 — ScanNet superlative and two aggregate values are inconsistent — Counterevidence: Restricting ScanNet claim to displayed GS methods without marked priors resolves it. Other two corrections do not reverse Ours ranking. Undisclosed weighting could explain means but requires evidence.
Limitations: No author-code execution, benchmark replication, raw-trajectory replay, memory profiling or video analysis.
